root_cause.text: The action deletion path (free_tcf) freed the memory via kfree() immediately without an RCU grace period, allowing a concurrent lookup via idr_find() under RCU to access freed memory (use-after-free).
root_cause.evidence: The patch description details the race: CPU0 holds a pointer from idr_find() under rcu_read_lock, then CPU1 removes and kfree()s the action before CPU0's refcount_inc_not_zero, leading to UAF. The fix re-adds struct rcu_head to tc_action and replaces kfree(p) with kfree_rcu(p, tcfa_rcu) to defer freeing until after an RCU grace period.
